subject: Preflight evidence & PO-ready package for BrightBridge - next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight evidence & PO-ready package for BrightBridge - next steps

Hi Sam,

Thanks for the productive demo and for confirming interest in Redwood for inference across your analytics stack. Legal and procurement asked that we bundle a "PO-ready" package so they can complete the vendor setup and issue a purchase order without a prolonged back-and-forth. Can you return the following as a single packet? Helpful to receive everything in one email or a shared Drive folder.

Essential items we need before procurement will create the PO:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest annual) or SOC 2 letter of attestation
- ISO 27001 certificate (scanned)
- Penetration test attestation or summary (redacted findings OK)
- Completed Redwood supplier onboarding form (we'll attach our template below)
- W-9 (for US vendors) or VAT documentation if applicable
- Primary contact for AP + remittance instructions (email + ACH/wire details)

Optional but will speed review:
- Sample DPA (if you have a standard one)
- System architecture diagram (high level)

I attached the onboarding form and a short checklist for the PO creation. Procurement at BrightBridge typically needs the compliance docs up front for their security gate. If you can confirm an ETA (e.g., 2–3 business days), we can align legal and procurement to issue the PO and expedite the SOW signing.

Thanks — I copied Dev (our procurement lead) and Laura (Customer Success lead) to coordinate next steps.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Supplier_Onboarding_Form_Template.pdf (form), PO_Checklist_for_Vendors.pdf (checklist)

From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brightbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@brightbridge.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight evidence & PO-ready package for BrightBridge - next steps

Hi Naomi — thanks, this is clear. I'm pulling the items together this morning. Quick status:

- SOC 2 Type II: we have a scanned copy from last quarter; will include.
- ISO 27001: certificate is with our compliance team — attaching the scanned cert.
- Pen test: we have an attestation letter from our vendor (redacted) — attaching.
- Supplier form: I'll complete your template and return it.
- W-9: attached.

One ask from AP: can you confirm Redwood's invoice remit address and whether you prefer ACH or wire? Also, do you require a specific PO line-item format (unit/term/renewal cadence)? If we submit the packet by end of day Monday (13 Apr), is that acceptable for your procurement to generate the PO?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Cho
Head of Vendor Ops, BrightBridge Health
sam.cho@brightbridge.com | +1 212-555-4450

Attachments: BrightBridge_W9_2026.pdf; ISO27001_certificate_scanned.pdf; pen-test-attestation-letter.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preflight evidence & PO-ready package for BrightBridge - next steps

Sam — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple clarifications for AP and to keep timelines tight:

- Remit: Redwood prefers ACH. Remit address for AP: payments@redwood.com. Full ACH details (bank name, routing/account) will be shared on the PO confirmation page once procurement issues the PO (we don't send ACH details over email for security).
- PO line-item: please include one line for "Redwood Inference Dedicated Capacity" with term (12 months) and estimated committed tokens or seats in the description. If you need a template, Dev is copied and can share our recommended line-item language.
- Timing: EOD Monday (13 Apr) is fine — we'll ask procurement to draft the PO on Tuesday and target a Wednesday issuance, assuming no outstanding compliance flags.

For legal: if you have a standard DPA, please include; if not, we'll route our template for signature via DocuSign.

Next actions:
- Sam: attach the packet (SOC2, ISO, pen-test letter, W-9, completed onboarding form).
- Dev: please confirm internal PO process and the person who will raise the PO in Coupa (or our finance system).
- Laura: once PO is issued, please coordinate kickoff for onboarding and SSO/training.

Thanks everyone.

—Naomi

Subject: Re: Preflight evidence & PO-ready package for BrightBridge - next steps

Hi Sam — appreciate the packet. Received and reviewed attachments (saved to our shared secure Drive). Next items from procurement/finance side:

1) We will raise the PO once we confirm file integrity and the SOC2/pen-test artifacts meet BrightBridge's security gating. I reviewed the SOC2 cover page and the pen-test attestation; looks standard but legal will confirm.

2) Please sign the attached SOW via DocuSign (link below) — we will not attach pricing in email; SOW references the PO number at time of issuance.

3) Please upload the completed Supplier_Onboarding_Form_Filled.pdf to the secure folder and confirm here. That form includes AP remittance fields we need to populate the PO.

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?token=abc123xyz
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/4582 (I added procurement checklist and marked compliance docs as "received - pending legal review").

If legal flags anything, Rishi will reach out directly to Sam for redlines. Otherwise, expect PO issuance tomorrow afternoon.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133
